svg.aria-label: Three rows. An event is a fact about something that already happened, such as OrderPlaced from the order service; it is broadcast to any subscriber, is immutable and is named in the past tense. A command is a request for something to happen, such as PlaceOrder from a client; it is addressed to one recipient, can be rejected and is named in the imperative mood. A message is the general envelope for data sent between systems and can carry an event or a command, with metadata such as headers
svg.text: Broadcast to any subscriber, no reply expected
Requests an action from one recipient
Can be rejected, modified, or redirected
Can carry events, commands, or other data
Includes metadata (headers, routing info, and so on)
A fact about something that already happened (past tense).
A request for something to happen in the future.
A general term for data sent between systems (can be a command or an event).
